verdict.rationale: Warp offers explicit natural-language command generation ('#' to describe commands, AI Command Suggestions), a built-in conversational agent mode for multi-step tasks, natural-language error explanation, and NL-driven workflow creation/naming, all well documented across first-party docs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of NL command accuracy and some community reports of feature breakage (e.g., 'clear' command issues) introduce minor real-world caveats.
